ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure contains two three-phase load wiring diagrams, (a) and (b). In figure (a), three identical impedances Z are connected end to end to form a triangle, that is, a balanced delta load, and three ammeters are connected on the three external lines, so the readings are line currents. In figure (b), the ammeters are connected into each Z branch of the delta load, measuring the load branch currents. Reasoning: In the given figure (a), the reading of each line ammeter is I_L = 8.66 A. In a balanced delta load, the relationship between line current and phase/branch current is I_L = sqrt(3) * I_phase. Therefore, in figure (b), the branch series ammeter reading is I_phase = I_L / sqrt(3) = 8.66 / 1.732 ≈ 5 A.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the load as a balanced delta. In figure (a), each external line ammeter reads the line current I_L = 8.66 A. In figure (b), the ammeter in series with a Z branch reads the delta branch current I_phase. Apply I_phase = I_L/sqrt(3) = 8.66/1.732 = 5 A, so the ammeter reads 5 A.

method.method_draft: Use figure (a)'s line ammeters to take I_L = 8.66 A and the text's line voltage U_L = 380 V. Since the image shows a delta load, each branch voltage equals the line voltage, U_branch = 380 V. Equate total apparent power from line quantities to the sum over branches: sqrt(3)·380·8.66 = 3·380·I_branch. Cancel 380 and solve I_branch = 8.66/sqrt(3) = 5 A. The figure (b) ammeter is in series with a branch, so it reads 5 A.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧的(a)电路有三条三相线路，每条线路上各串接一个电流表；负载由三个相同阻抗Z首尾相接成三角形连接，即Δ形负载。图中右侧的(b)电路仍是同一个三角形负载，但电流表改为串接在各个负载支路中，用来测量支路电流。

推理：题给(a)中每个线路电流表读数为8.66 A，所以线电流 I_L = 8.66 A；线电压 U_L = 380 V。由于图像显示负载为三角形连接，三角形负载每个支路两端电压等于线电压，因此 U_branch = U_L = 380 V。对称三相负载的总视在功率可由线量表示为 S = sqrt(3)·U_L·I_L，也可由三个相同支路相加表示为 S = 3·U_branch·I_branch。代入并相等：sqrt(3)·380·8.66 = 3·380·I_branch。约去380，得到 I_branch = 8.66 / sqrt(3) ≈ 5 A。图(b)中的电流表串接在负载支路中，因此读数就是支路电流。
